tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
You recently took a tour of the city’s Grand Kabwe Theater with some friends. You observed the following.
Write an email to the theater. In your email, do the following:
-a) Thank the tour guide for the tour.
-b) Describe something you remember seeing at the theater.
-c) Ask whether your friend’s mobile phone has been found.
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: Pictures on display showing the theater’s construction.
Actors rehearsing for the opening of a new play.
tasks.to: the theater Subject: letter of thanks and the search for the mobile phone
tasks.subject: letter of thanks and the search for the mobile phone
tasks.sample:
Dear Grand Kabwe Theater,

This morning I took a tour of the theater with a friend and we thoroughly enjoyed it. We learned a lot about the history of the theater from the pictures showing the theater's construction, and it was exciting to see actors rehearsing for the upcoming play. However, somehow during the tour, my friend lost her mobile phone. Can you tell me has anybody seen it?    

Thank you,  

Eddie
tasks.title: Write an Email
